Messages.Author: Jonathan_Sicari
Messages.Body:
[quote] Projectile
Type(s): Combat
Discipline(s): Celerity
Rarity: Common
Artist(s): Veronica Jones
Set(s): *Kindred Most Wanted
* Set card was introduced
Card Text:
[cel] Strike: 1R damage or make a ranged weapon strike. This strike
cannot be dodged.
[CEL] As above, with an additional strike.

Clarifications and Rulings
A vampire who maneuvers with a gun may still use Projectile to shoot
with that gun as his initial strike that round. [LSJ 20050304]

Cannot be used to strike with a weapon that isn't ranged (that is,
with a weapon whose strike isn't ranged). [LSJ 20050224] [/quote]

This came up at a game Saturday. Can a character with Superior
Celerity and a maneuver from another source (quicken sight) maneuver
to long, strike for 1R (undodgeable) with Projectile at superior and
then strike for 1R (undodgeable) without playing another Projectile
(the player claimed that the as above, with an additional strike
permitted it).

Thank you,

Jonathan
